content.question: What is a pre-trained model?
options: A model that trains itself while running on the user's device.
A model with randomly initialized weights that has never seen data.
A model that only works on the exact dataset it was built for.
A pre-built model trained on a vast amount of data by experts, made to be reused.
content.answer: A pre-built model trained on a vast amount of data by experts, made to be reused.
